pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Pale Garden-themed bow. 1536 durability (4x vanilla bow). Enchantable (Power, Flame, Punch, Infinity, etc.).

Vulnerability effect: arrows apply +50% damage taken for 5s. Stacks with Pale Doll's fear aura (total +100%).
Repair: resin.

pages.title: Pale Doll Exclusive
pages.text:
When the Pale Doll uses the Pale Bow:

• No arrows required — fires without ammo
• Faster draw time
• Faster arrow velocity

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: 3 resin bricks + 3 string, arranged like a vanilla bow.
